The corresponding source for this beta, including pinned dependency sources,
licenses, and build instructions, is available alongside the binary package:
https://github.com/johannes-schmieder/fereg/releases/download/v0.5.0-beta.2/fereg-0.5.0-source.zip

For a modified local build, its source is the checkout used to build it.
